text: At the invitation of the Indigenous Affairs Office, a community member will provide a presentation on the Proactive Response to Support Indigenous Children, Youth, and Families in Crisis, including a discussion on creating after-hours Indigenous children and youth mobile crisis response team.

The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Executive Committee request the Director, Indigenous Affairs Office, to report back to the next meeting of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee on how to foster better dialogue between Toronto divisions, agencies and committees, and Toronto’s Indigenous communities.
